description: Reproducibility package: Open-data critical-access screening for compound heat-flood infrastructure risk in low-data cities is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Saleem Ahmed Al-Azazi, Abdullateef Ali (Taiz University). Reproducibility package for the Scientific Reports manuscript "Open-data critical-access screening for compound heat-flood infrastructure risk in low-data cities". The archive contains the frozen analysis scripts, exact source-data manifests and SHA-256 checksums, 37 machine-readable reported outputs, six main figures, one supplementary figure, sensitivity analyses, validation scripts, and clean-room verification records. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
